title: PixelPeak
description: The PixelPeak Minecraft server provides a hardcore experience similar to Rust, with monthly wipes
body:
Welcome to PixelPeak, the ultimate Survival PvP experience in Minecraft with a Rust-like twist! 🌟

PixelPeak is a high-stakes, survival PvP server where every decision matters. Form teams, build your base, and fight for dominance in a world where danger lurks around every corner. But beware, death is not the end—when you fall, a grave appears, and your loot is up for grabs by anyone daring enough to take it.

🔐 Key Features:
- Monthly Wipes: The server wipes every month on the 1st, ensuring a fresh start and a constantly evolving battlefield.
- Teams/Clans: Join forces with friends or make new allies to survive and thrive in this harsh world.
- Graves: When you die, a grave is left behind, containing your loot. Other players can find and loot your grave, so choose your battles wisely.
- Loot Drops: TNT and other valuable resources can only be obtained from loot drops, which occur every 6 hours. Keep an eye out and be ready to fight for your share!
  
On PixelPeak, every moment is a fight for survival. Will you rise to the top or fall to the wayside? Join us and find out!
